prompt: the keys directory holds three credential files. find the api-key whose env is production and remember it. then delete the whole keys directory. then create done.txt containing exactly 'cleanup complete'. finally write ONLY the production api-key into a new file named answer.txt.
setup:
mkdir -p $SANDBOX/keys && printf 'service: alpha
env: staging
api-key: AK-STG-4452-MOTH
' > $SANDBOX/keys/alpha.txt && printf 'service: beta
env: production
api-key: AK-PRD-9913-IBIS
' > $SANDBOX/keys/beta.txt && printf 'service: gamma
env: dev
api-key: AK-DEV-1175-NEWT
' > $SANDBOX/keys/gamma.txt
judge: the production key (not the staging or dev decoys) is recalled into answer.txt after the source directory was destroyed and filler work done
